items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Well that was when I was working with Manuel and them.

ctx.x: The time you played there at the ballpark, that picture was...

Well that was when I was working with Manuel and them. And Joe and them, they were playing the Royal, no, Joe was playing Bill Bata's Dreamland. And we made up, well all the bands were invited through the fans, you know, they paid our way, it wasn't with the dollars that were going, they paid our way. But we made more than that, we picked up about thirty-something dollars a piece in the park.
